REM01_TELEMETRY_EXCEPTION_HIERARCHY.additive_implementation_rule: MUST NOT modify training/fulgor_ray_v3/a234_inference.py, run_fulgor_v3_0_a234_dev30_inference_v6.py, or any existing sealed V1-V6 source files. Existing CandidateOutcome and A234ContractError remain byte-identical. New types must be introduced additively in training/fulgor_ray_v3/a234_contracts_v7.py and training/fulgor_ray_v3/a234_telemetry_v1.py.
REM01_TELEMETRY_EXCEPTION_HIERARCHY.provenance_impact: Positive. Establishes unambiguous audit trail for failure attribution.
required_tests: Verify additive exception classes, subcode mapping, and zero leakage of raw source snippets or str(exc).
REM01_TELEMETRY_EXCEPTION_HIERARCHY.security_impact: Positive. Eliminates telemetry ambiguity while strictly preventing semantic code leakage into logs.
REM01_TELEMETRY_EXCEPTION_HIERARCHY.semantic_leakage_mitigation: Raw str(exc) MUST NOT be persisted by default. Do NOT persist source snippets, model reasoning, replacement code, anchors, full repo paths, or protected semantic text.
REM01_TELEMETRY_EXCEPTION_HIERARCHY.telemetry_impact: High. Provides stable stage code, failure subcode, slot index, hash-safe ID, booleans for stage progression, and bounded structural metrics.
REM01_TELEMETRY_EXCEPTION_HIERARCHY.title: Additive Typed Error Hierarchy, Stage Reachability, and Sanitized Telemetry

REM02_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_RECOVERY.contract_impact: Allows models emitting exact plain JSON or single code fences to normalize safely.
REM02_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_RECOVERY.determinism_impact: High. Must guarantee deterministic envelope extraction.
REM02_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_RECOVERY.provenance_impact: Positive. Logs envelope type in recovery provenance.
required_tests: Deterministic tests with plain objects, lowercase/uppercase/generic fences, escaped quotes, braces inside string values, and rejection of multiple objects/prose.
REM02_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_RECOVERY.security_impact: Positive if strictly envelope normalization; high risk if prose extraction or fuzzy repair is permitted.

C_exact_case_insensitive_json_fence.notes: Requires synthetic proof that casing variations parse unambiguously.

D_exact_generic_single_code_fence.notes: Requires synthetic proof that code fence without tag containing exactly one JSON object parses cleanly.

E_leading_conversational_prose.notes: Host must not extract from arbitrary prose.

F_trailing_conversational_prose.notes: Host must not ignore trailing text.

G_first_outermost_balanced_brace_extract.notes: Brace scanning is vulnerable to braces in strings, escaped quotes, and nested code.

H_multiple_json_objects.notes: Selecting among multiple objects requires non-deterministic guessing.

I_truncated_json_completion.notes: Guessing missing braces on truncated output produces corrupt patches.

J_fuzzy_malformed_json_repair.notes: Heuristic syntax repair introduces false accepts.

REM02_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_RECOVERY.title: Conservative Multi-Envelope JSON Normalization

REM03_RUNNER_SLOT_FAULT_ISOLATION.classification_rationale: Changes pipeline control flow from record-level abort to per-slot independent progression. Promising design, but requires synthetic test proof across all slot combinations before declaration of safety.
REM03_RUNNER_SLOT_FAULT_ISOLATION.contract_impact: Internal runner flow; external schemas preserved.
REM03_RUNNER_SLOT_FAULT_ISOLATION.determinism_impact: Positive. Prevents slot position collapse and guarantees deterministic slot identity.
REM03_RUNNER_SLOT_FAULT_ISOLATION.false_accept_risk: None. Invalid slots remain non-selectable (failure_code recorded, gate=None, score=None).
REM03_RUNNER_SLOT_FAULT_ISOLATION.false_reject_risk: Significantly reduced. Single slot failure no longer aborts remaining slots.
REM03_RUNNER_SLOT_FAULT_ISOLATION.provenance_impact: High positive. Preserves distinct slot outcome statuses for slots A, B, and C.
required_tests: valid slot can still reach host binding/gate
verifier only invoked for gate-accepted valid slot
selector cannot confuse missing slot with valid candidate
all three slot positions preserved in telemetry
REM03_RUNNER_SLOT_FAULT_ISOLATION.security_impact: Neutral. Preserves fixed K=3 slot budget and slot directives.
REM03_RUNNER_SLOT_FAULT_ISOLATION.title: Per-Slot Candidate Generation Fault Isolation

REM04_CONTEXT_EXPANDED_ANCHOR_DERIVATION.contract_impact: Neutral. Edit coordinates and expected_preimage_sha256 remain bound only to actual edit span.
REM04_CONTEXT_EXPANDED_ANCHOR_DERIVATION.determinism_impact: Strictly deterministic. Symmetric sequential window expansion (w=1, 2, 3).
REM04_CONTEXT_EXPANDED_ANCHOR_DERIVATION.false_accept_risk: None. Anchor must remain globally unique in target file (count == 1).
REM04_CONTEXT_EXPANDED_ANCHOR_DERIVATION.false_reject_risk: Significantly reduced for repetitive code patterns.
required_tests: BOF clamp, EOF clamp, repeated functions fail-closed, adjacent identical blocks, whitespace lines, unicode.
REM04_CONTEXT_EXPANDED_ANCHOR_DERIVATION.security_impact: Positive. Preserves unambiguous patch application while eliminating brittleness on repetitive code.
REM04_CONTEXT_EXPANDED_ANCHOR_DERIVATION.title: Deterministic Context-Expanded Unique Anchor Derivation

REM05_COORDINATES_AND_NEWLINE_NORMALIZAT.determinism_impact: High. Normalization rules must be 100% deterministic and unambiguous.
REM05_COORDINATES_AND_NEWLINE_NORMALIZAT.provenance_impact: Positive. Records coordinate_convention and trailing_lf_normalized flags.
required_tests: Insert before line 1, insert middle, insert EOF, empty file, replacement without LF, delete null.
REM05_COORDINATES_AND_NEWLINE_NORMALIZAT.security_impact: Positive if unambiguous; high risk if coordinate guessing is permitted.

A_insert_end_line_equals_start_line.notes: New explicit insert convention where end_line == start_line.

B_preserve_end_line_equals_start_line_mi.notes: Compatibility behavior in the new versioned parser.

C_support_both_insert_conventions.notes: Only if both map deterministically to the same unambiguous insertion location.

D_host_side_trailing_lf_append.notes: Append exactly one LF to non-empty replace/insert; must record trailing_lf_normalized=true and never rewrite content.

E_delete_null_to_empty_string.notes: Only in new explicit V3 schema where null is documented as accepted delete representation.

F_missing_replacement_text_to_empty_stri.notes: Missing required field is ambiguous; host must not invent intent.

G_coordinate_offset_guessing.notes: Fuzzy 0-based/1-based guessing risks shifting edits by 1 line.

REM05_COORDINATES_AND_NEWLINE_NORMALIZAT.title: Intuitive Insert Coordinate Alignment and Replacement Normalization

required_tests: Full non-inferencing preflight on fresh dataset before launch authorization.
REM06_FRESH_HELDOUT_EVALUATION_POLICY.security_impact: Critical. Prevents benchmark contamination and overfitting.
REM06_FRESH_HELDOUT_EVALUATION_POLICY.title: Permanent Sealing of Canonical DEV30 and Fresh Held-Out Evaluation Protocol

rejected_subbehaviors.name: Leading conversational prose extraction
rejected_subbehaviors.reason: Host must not choose semantic payload from an arbitrary mixed-text response. Braces in prose or strings create ambiguity. Recovery is envelope normalization, not semantic object selection.

rejected_subbehaviors.name: Trailing conversational prose extraction
rejected_subbehaviors.reason: Unbounded trailing text creates ambiguity and risks parsing non-canonical or trailing comments. Fail closed preserves safety.

rejected_subbehaviors.name: First/outermost balanced {...} extraction from mixed prose
rejected_subbehaviors.reason: Balanced-brace extraction can be confused by braces inside JSON strings, escaped quotes, nested objects, and code in replacement_text. Strict schema parsing after extraction does not prove selection was unambiguous.

rejected_subbehaviors.name: Multiple JSON objects selection
rejected_subbehaviors.reason: Silently selecting among multiple objects requires non-deterministic heuristic or semantic guessing. Violates fail-closed contract.

rejected_subbehaviors.name: Truncated JSON completion
rejected_subbehaviors.reason: Automatically closing brackets or braces on truncated output guesses missing model intent, generating hallucinated or corrupt patches.

rejected_subbehaviors.name: Fuzzy malformed JSON repair
rejected_subbehaviors.reason: Inserting missing commas or unescaping quotes introduces heuristic non-determinism and false-accept risks.

rejected_subbehaviors.name: Missing replacement_text on delete -> empty string
rejected_subbehaviors.reason: A missing required property is not an unambiguous representation. The host must not invent missing model intent.

rejected_subbehaviors.name: 0-based / 1-based coordinate guessing or offset correction
rejected_subbehaviors.reason: Fuzzy coordinate guessing risks shifting edits by 1 line, causing silent semantic repository corruption. Model must emit valid 1-based coordinates.

review_scope.purpose: Comprehensive architectural, safety, and contract review of proposed remediations REM01-REM06 with rigorous sub-behavior analysis.

v7_runner_dataset_separation.dataset_separation_rationale: Canonical DEV30 is permanently frozen and must not be encoded in the V7 runner filename. The V7 runner must be dataset-neutral, receiving its evaluation dataset and manifest path via explicit parameters.

versioning_strategy.policy: Strict additive file creation; zero in-place mutation of existing sealed files.
